searchText: Hey <@199561711278227457> - is it possible to get some genesis validators for devnet-6 so I can test vouch when the devnet goes live? Yup, I can do that! 😄 We can also do deposits soon after if you want to see the full flow for a validator on vouch. Whatever you prefer. Yeah I'll likely test the deposits after, but I want to test pre and post fork and , assuming we fork at epoch 4, I'm probably going to need a genesis validator for that 😅 Are there any mev-relays for devnet-5? not yet, we're sorting out a relay bug. But bloxroute is also in the process of setting one up. Thanks for the quick response. Is there a thread or something I can monitor to find out when it's available? ill announce it in the interop channel I deposited for 60 validators that I'm not running on devnet5. I don't want to disrupt the testnet too much. Those are mostly for tests that doesn't require them to be running for now. Am I fine with leaving them offline? Yeah that should be fine 🙂
